title: Finagotchi Daily Quest List
description: Quest list payload exchanged between the Finagotchi server and the Solana Mobile app. Both sides regenerate it deterministically from (wallet, day, ActivityProfile, questHistory) using @finagotchi/quest-engine.

schemaVersion.description: Bump on any breaking change to the determinism contract.

wallet.description: Base58 Solana wallet address the quests were generated for.

day.description: UTC day the quest list belongs to.

generatedAt.description: unix ms when this payload was materialized. Informational only; never feeds generation.

kind.description: count: >= goal txs in window; streak: >= goal distinct active UTC days in window; explore: >= 1 tx on a program outside the wallet's habits.

goal.description: count: required tx count; streak: required distinct active days; explore: always 1.

windowDays.description: Length of the trailing UTC-day window the quest is evaluated over (currently always 7).

xp.description: XP credited on verification. clamp(10 * goal, 10, 200); explore quests are 25.
